tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return identity details for the AEO Goal account this MCP connection is authorized as.

tools.name: list_tracked_brands
tools.description: List the AEO Goal brands this user is tracking. The active brand is marked with `*`. Other tools default to the active brand when brand_name is omitted.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the tracked products (SKUs) under a brand for agentic-commerce product tracking. Defaults to the active brand when brand_name is omitted.

tools.name: get_share_of_mind
tools.description: Return the brand's Share of Mind (% of tracked AI answers that mention the brand) over a recent window, with a delta vs the prior equal-length window. Defaults: active brand, all engines, 30 days.

tools.name: get_citation_rank
tools.description: Return the brand's latest citation rank position across each AI engine for a specific tracked prompt. Identify the prompt either by prompt_id (exact) or prompt_text (case-insensitive substring of tracked prompts; must match exactly one).

tools.name: get_keyword_rankings
tools.description: Get the current SERP keyword ranking positions for a brand. Returns the latest snapshot per tracked keyword: position, URL, and SERP features. Requires TRADITIONAL_SEO_ENABLED or DataForSEO credentials.

tools.name: get_backlink_summary
tools.description: Get aggregate backlink stats for a brand: total backlinks, referring domain count, average domain authority, and top anchor texts. Requires TRADITIONAL_SEO_ENABLED or DataForSEO credentials.

tools.name: compare_vs_competitor
tools.description: Compare a brand's organic traffic and keyword footprint against a competitor domain. Returns competitor traffic estimate, keyword count, and shared/exclusive keyword buckets. Requires TRADITIONAL_SEO_ENABLED or DataForSEO credentials.

tools.name: list_tracked_prompts
tools.description: List the AI prompts being tracked for a brand, with last-checked timestamp and total check count. Prompts are the queries AEO Goal sends to AI engines to monitor brand citations.

tools.name: get_recent_citations
tools.description: List recent raw citation probes for a brand across all tracked prompts. Each row shows the AI engine, whether the brand was mentioned, its position, and the prompt text. Use to spot citation drops or audit coverage.

tools.name: get_competitor_citation_gaps
tools.description: List tracked prompts where competitors are cited by AI engines but the brand is absent. These are content gaps - queries you should be answering. Use generate_content(from_keyword_gaps=true) to draft responses for them.

tools.name: get_content_score
tools.description: Return the AEO quality score, publish status, and title for one or more blog posts. Read-only - does not mutate generation state. Use get_content_job to poll in-progress generation jobs.

tools.name: add_tracked_prompts
tools.description: Add one or more AI prompts to a brand's tracking so AEO Goal starts monitoring brand citations for them. Idempotent - an already-tracked prompt is re-activated, not duplicated. Defaults to the active brand when brand_name is omitted. Requires the platform:write scope.

tools.name: add_tracked_keywords
tools.description: Add one or more SERP keywords to a brand's rank tracking. Idempotent on the SERP identity (domain+keyword+device+location). Defaults to the active brand. Requires TRADITIONAL_SEO_ENABLED / DataForSEO credentials and the platform:write scope.

tools.name: set_brand_competitors
tools.description: Replace a brand's tracked competitor list. This drives both the Competitors view and what the citation crawler detects. Merges existing website/logo by name and clamps to the plan's competitor cap. Defaults to the active brand. Requires the platform:write scope.

tools.name: suggest_tracked_prompts
tools.description: Generate AI-suggested tracking prompts for a brand, grounded in its onboarding/site intelligence and deduped against already-tracked prompts. Returns suggestions only - it does NOT track them; pass the ones you want to add_tracked_prompts. Read-only (platform:read).

tools.name: list_blogs
tools.description: Find your saved draft and published blogs by title, with pagination. Returns IDs for get_content_draft, which reads either publish state. Only your own blogs in this connection's allowed brands are visible.

tools.name: get_content_draft
tools.description: Read one of your saved draft or published blogs as Markdown by ID from list_blogs. Never publishes or edits it. The live MCP grant and its brand allowlist apply.

tools.name: generate_content
tools.description: Generate AEO/blog content DRAFTS from a brand's data. Provide any of: titles (explicit topics), from_prompt_ids (tracked prompts to answer), from_keyword_gaps=true (auto-draft for prompts where competitors are cited but the brand isn't), and reference_urls (evidence to ground the draft). Drafts are

tools.name: get_content_job
tools.description: Poll the status of content drafts created by generate_content. Pass the blog_ids it returned; each job reports status (queued|generating|completed|failed), stage, quality score, and a review URL. Only your own drafts are visible.

tools.name: refine_blog_draft
tools.description: Revise one owned unpublished blog draft from feedback. Saves the prior version, charges one AI-query unit, and queues an async job. Never publishes. Review the result in the app before publishing.

tools.name: propose_blog_publish
tools.description: Request human approval to publish one saved unpublished blog. The owner reviews the exact draft in the app; the server rechecks content, plan, ownership, and brand before publishing. This tool never publishes.

tools.name: get_brand_context
tools.description: Read writing guidance and voice profiles for one authorized brand. Excludes uploaded document contents and integration credentials.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Render an AEO Goal report as a PDF. Small reports (<1MB) come back inline as base64; larger ones are persisted to media storage and returned as a 1-hour signed download URL. Returns the same content the user sees in /app/reports - single source of truth. Requires the white-label feature flag (Enterp

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Create a public, tokenized share link for a report so the agency can hand a URL to a client without granting them an AEO Goal login. Requires the white-label feature flag.

tools.name: get_organization_branding
tools.description: Return the organization's white-label branding (logo URL, brand colors, sender name, support email). Requires the white-label feature flag; the platform:read scope alone is not enough.

tools.name: list_report_shares
tools.description: Find your active public report shares, newest first. A brand-restricted connection sees only links for its allowed brands.

tools.name: list_generated_reports
tools.description: Find saved PDF reports generated through this account's MCP connection, newest first. Use get_generated_report to obtain a fresh download link.

tools.name: get_generated_report
tools.description: Get a fresh, short-lived download link for one saved PDF report.

tools.name: list_audit_fixes
tools.description: List the current site-audit findings and their recommended fixes for a tracked brand's site, as an actionable work-list. Use this to pull the SEO/AEO issues AEOGoal found so you can implement the fixes yourself (in the client's own codebase / CMS); it never writes to their site. Returns the affected

tools.name: scan_pages
tools.description: Trigger Quality Gate audit scans for one or more pages on a brand's site. Returns immediately with a per-URL dispatch status; scans run in the background (about 10-30s each). Call list_audit_fixes afterwards to see the findings, or re-call scan_pages to check which are still running. Omit urls to sc

tools.name: get_ai_referral_performance
tools.description: First-party AI referral sessions, conversions, net revenue, and Share of Mind by engine, with observed/modelled confidence.

tools.name: get_conversion_attribution
tools.description: First-party conversion attribution from AI referrals, including conversion counts, net revenue, and Share of Mind by engine.

tools.name: get_revenue_by_ai_engine
tools.description: Net first-party conversion revenue by AI engine and attribution confidence tier.

tools.name: get_ai_conversion_dead_ends
tools.description: AI traffic sources with meaningful sessions but zero conversions.

tools.name: get_google_ads_feed_status
tools.description: Google Ads offline conversion-feed status for the selected brand; never returns feed credentials.

tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.description: List ranked opportunities with evidence, expected impact, confidence, effort, cost, risk and measurement windows.

tools.name: build_action_plan
tools.description: Build an approval-gated action plan without changing data.

tools.name: create_remediation_ticket
tools.description: Create a tracked remediation ticket and draft. Does not publish.

tools.name: draft_page_changes
tools.description: Generate or regenerate a reviewable opportunity draft. Does not publish.

tools.name: approve_action
tools.description: Approve a draft, optionally merging human edits. Organization admin required; does not publish.

tools.name: execute_approved_action
tools.description: Execute an approved action. Organization admin required.

tools.name: get_action_status
tools.description: Get draft, execution and 7/14/28-day measurement status.

tools.name: rollback_action
tools.description: Rollback a reversible auto-applied action and reopen its ticket. Organization admin required.

tools.name: measure_action_impact
tools.description: Return honest measured or pending results for 7, 14 and 28 days.

tools.name: create_execution
tools.description: Queue one durable site audit execution and return an execution ID immediately.

tools.name: get_execution
tools.description: Read a durable execution and its steps.

tools.name: list_executions
tools.description: List recent durable executions for the authorized brands.

tools.name: cancel_execution
tools.description: Request cooperative cancellation of a durable execution.

tools.name: retry_execution_step
tools.description: Retry the failed audit scan step without replaying a completed scan.

tools.name: get_work_status
tools.description: Check a saved blog generation job, durable audit execution, or opportunity action by its returned ID. Uses each workflow's existing authorization and brand restrictions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_keyword_rankings, get_content_score, get_content_job, get_organization_branding, list_audit_fixes, scan_pages, get_google_ads_feed_status · Private data: get_keyword_rankings, get_backlink_summary, compare_vs_competitor, add_tracked_keywords, get_brand_context, get_google_ads_feed_status · Public sink: get_share_of_mind, get_content_score, list_blogs, propose_blog_publish, create_share_link, get_organization_branding, get_ai_referral_performance, get_conversion_attribution, create_remediation_ticket, draft_page_changes, approve_action · Destructive: scan_pages, execute_approved_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_keyword_rankings, get_content_score, get_content_job, get_organization_branding, list_audit_fixes, scan_pages, get_google_ads_feed_status · Private data: get_keyword_rankings, get_backlink_summary, compare_vs_competitor, add_tracked_keywords, get_brand_context, get_google_ads_feed_status · Public sink: get_share_of_mind, get_content_score, list_blogs, propose_blog_publish, create_share_link, get_organization_branding, get_ai_referral_performance, get_conversion_attribution, create_remediation_ticket, draft_page_changes, approve_action · Destructive: scan_pages, execute_approved_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
